test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Which legal act mandates the protection of monuments like the Hammam?

options.text: The Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains Act, 1958

solution:
The Correct Answer is __**The Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains Act, 1958**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Allahabad High Court provided interim protection to the Hammam of Ali Vardi Khan in Agra and instructed the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) and state authorities to ensure no damage occurs to the heritage site.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **Hammam**, located in **Chipitola, Agra**, was **constructed in 1620 AD** during the Mughal era by **Ali Vardi Khan**.
 
• It was originally part of a **larger inn complex** and served as a **bathhouse** as well as a **cultural and social center**.
 
• It was recognized as a heritage site following an **ASI survey in October 2023**.
 
• A PIL was filed to protect the **Hammam** from **illegal and unauthorized demolition**.
 
• The PIL highlighted the **imminent threat** to the **400-year-old** monument, prompting judicial intervention.
 
• Under the **Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains Act, 1958**, the **ASI** and state authorities have a legal obligation to **protect** and **preserve** ancient monuments like the Hammam.
